proposedContracts.name: parses copy as an option-free identity operator over the whole negotiation table on every path
proposedContracts.scope: option-free identity descriptor, no conversion stage for any of the 14 table formats

proposedContracts.name: refuses every copy option and enable= with VideoFilterParseError before planning on every path
proposedContracts.scope: VideoFilterParseError for options and enable= before planning

proposedContracts.name: forwards the frame unchanged on the linear, graph and replay paths within budgets and signals
proposedContracts.scope: unchanged forwarding, budgets, AbortSignal, frame-shape mismatch, padded strides, unmutated input

proposedContracts.name: forwards the frame unchanged through activation actors and the timed executor and refuses runtime commands
proposedContracts.scope: unchanged forwarding and native runtime command codes

proposedContracts.name: matches native -vf copy chains across all 14 formats, sizes and timing scopes as rawvideo and framecrc
proposedContracts.scope: -vf copy, copy,negate, format=nv12,copy,vflip and copy,hflip over all 14 rawvideo input formats, 5x3/7x5/8x6, 3 frames, three -ss/-t scopes, rawvideo and framecrc

proposedContracts.name: matches native -filter_complex split and copy branches across all 14 formats as rawvideo and framecrc
proposedContracts.scope: four split/copy -filter_complex graphs, two outputs each, all 14 formats at 7x5, rawvideo and framecrc, with and without -ss/-frames:v

proposedContracts.name: matches native replayed copy graphs frame by frame across all 14 formats and sizes
proposedContracts.scope: createReplayVideoExecution over four copy graphs, all 14 formats and three sizes, rawvideo bytes and pts

proposedContracts.name: matches native copy through activation actors and the timed backend as rawvideo and framecrc
proposedContracts.scope: createFrameActors rawvideo and createTimedVideoBackend rawvideo/framecrc for copy, copy,hflip, format=nv12,copy,vflip and copy,copy over all 14 formats and three sizes

proposedContracts.name: refuses copy options before opening any output, as native does except for the generic threads option
proposedContracts.scope: option and enable= refusal before any output is opened on the media and timed backends

notes: Identity role with no frame function, like null; formats omitted so the whole 14-entry table is accepted, matching native query_formats (rejects only hwaccel).
Registry examples: copy, copy,hflip, format=nv12,copy,vflip; run on all five paths by the unedited registry test.
Native accepts copy=threads=1 (generic AVFilterContext option); bareStep refuses it, which is the explicit refusal the spec requires.
Identity forwards the same frame object, so stride or storage defects are detected by the next materializing operator, not by copy itself; documented and unit-tested via copy,hflip.
No shared edits beyond the two registry lines were needed.
Setup durations: submodule 41s, npm ci 9s, reference:build 198s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 68s, baseline unit suite 88s, differential suite 80s.
Baseline and final unit failures are identical: FLAC artifacts (downloads.xiph.org blocked) and resample-checkpoint macOS digests.
